units.text: INT. HOUSING COURT - COURTROOM 3 - MORNING
A cramped courtroom with a leaking ceiling tile and a plastic bucket underneath.
A worn carpet, three rows of benches, a flag on a crooked pole.
JUDGE HORTENSE ABBOTT-LUND, 60s, reading glasses perched on a long nose, peers over the bench.
LANDLORD DEXTER OLUYEMI, 40s, cufflinks, signet ring, stands at one table.
TENANT MARISELA QUINTANILLA, 30s, in her work uniform from a bakery, flour still on one sleeve, stands at the other.
Beside her, ATTY.
CORNELIUS PRATT, 50s, a threadbare suit, a briefcase with a broken clasp.
Mr. Oluyemi, you've served notice?
units.name: ABBOTT-LUND

units.text: Yes, Your Honor.
units.name: DEXTER

units.text: Mr. Pratt, you dispute it?
units.name: ABBOTT-LUND

units.text: We do, Your Honor. My client wasn't informed of the rent increase.
units.name: PRATT

units.text: It was posted in the lobby.
units.name: DEXTER

units.text: There's no lobby. There's a hallway.
units.name: MARISELA

units.text: Same thing.
units.name: DEXTER

units.text: There's a hallway with a broken light. I can't read in the dark.
units.name: MARISELA

units.text: Ms. Quintanilla, please address me.
units.name: ABBOTT-LUND

units.text: Sorry, Judge.
units.name: MARISELA

units.text: Mr. Pratt, any further objection?
units.name: ABBOTT-LUND

units.text: Only that Mr. Oluyemi has been collecting rent for a unit that doesn't have a working stove for six months.
units.name: PRATT

units.text: I replaced the stove.
units.name: DEXTER

units.text: With a hot plate.
units.name: MARISELA

units.text: That's enough.
units.name: ABBOTT-LUND

units.text: The bucket under the ceiling tile pings with a single drop.
